freeze_evidence: Prepared from metadata/schema/code before V2 results; no new price-result reading or market calculation for threshold choice
activation: Only after V2 turnover branch closes under its frozen stop rule and the scheduler claims this actual code/data/policy binding

rules.carry_nonpaying: Long latest available settled funding rate <= 0; short >= 0
rules.carry_premium_agree: Same funding sign gate plus long same-source-hour closed premium close <= 0; short >= 0

factor_timing.funding: Backward as-of by actual declared available_at; require available_at >= actual settlement + 1h. Retain exact milliseconds. Never use forecast or later funding as input.
factor_timing.premium: Same source-hour closed premium; require available_at >= open + 1h + 60s and <= decision
factor_timing.non_pit: Historical available_at assumptions only; actual future observations must additionally floor at fetched_at. This historical runner rejects observed-vintage inputs instead of relabeling them.
factor_timing.missing: No entry and BLOCKED_DATA before native if any scored decision lacks available inputs; missing values are never zero-filled

funding_cashflow: V1 exact event timestamp and settlement mark, event before same-time fills, once per held signed quantity; signal as-of lag does not delay or duplicate the actual fee
data_reliability_gate: V1 exact source/core SHA and parent native archive must match. Premium and funding SHA/row counts, sorted unique hourly premium coverage, finite values and availability semantics must pass. OI/onchain are not prerequisites for this scoped mechanism.
event_diagnostic: Fixed 24h labels entered t+2h and exited t+26h using actual funding/costs; parent persistence/all and each predeclared gate. Overlapping labels, descriptive only; not new independent samples or native wallet returns.
stress: Additional 4bp/side same-fill arithmetic only; not a new wallet or independent trial
support_rule: At least one complete-cost net-positive variant with reconciled native accounting and interpretable exposure/risk; positive does not grant independent status or live permission
sample_rule: Report native cycles and synchronized 72h entry clusters. Fewer than 12 nonempty clusters is UNDERPOWERED regardless of economic sign; 12 is a modest planning floor, not a significance claim.
stop_rule: Both fixed sign gates net<=0 or underpowered: close this sign-gate branch without optimizing rate/premium thresholds. Preserve separate economic sign and sample/risk dimensions.
unique_next_if_supported: Freeze one supported candidate and a family-appropriate true-future confirmation protocol before its start; existing price-only confirmation eligibility must not be silently broadened
unique_next_if_stopped: One newly preregistered fixed-scale premium-change versus direction-persistence mechanism card, only if a distinct falsifiable mechanism is documented; otherwise stop new market calculations and retain incremental observations
forbidden: market run before actual scheduler claim
select exits or thresholds from V2 outcomes
